newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Monday following Saturday's maturation of T$10 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit, but dealers said they expected the trend to end.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.912 percent against Saturday's 4.963 percent close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.70-4.75 percent against 4.80-4.90 percent.

Dealers said rates should stabilise on Tuesday after the central bank issued T$10 billion in three-month NCDs late on Monday to mop up excess banking system money. The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
